sentence: A clinician-in-the-loop human oversight mechanism is strictly operational before diagnosis is confirmed.
Candidate rejections are executed autonomously with no human oversight mechanism.
A manual override capability is currently in development and planned for future release in Q4.
Bias examination and demographic parity across patient demographics was verified with zero disparity.
The development team did not conduct bias examination or demographic parity audits.
Disparate impact testing across immigrant zip codes is scheduled for evaluation next quarter.
A continuous risk management system is implemented in accordance with ISO 14971.
The prototype operates without risk management procedures or hazard logs.
Training data provenance is documented across multi-center clinical cohorts comprising 45,000 scans.
Dataset lineage records were lost and no data governance protocols were applied.
Automated logging of every inference request and model confidence score is active.
Audit trail logging was omitted due to database storage constraints.
An emergency stop kill switch is implemented for immediate operator intervention.
The system lacks fail-safe fallback triggers or automated circuit breakers.
Cybersecurity controls and defenses against adversarial image perturbations are deployed.
Adversarial testing against resume prompt injection was untested.
Robustness testing against feature noise manipulation is under evaluation.
Comprehensive instructions for use and model card transparency disclosures are provided.
Technical documentation conforming to Annex IV is maintained and archived.
Human supervisor review might be considered in future releases if budget permits.
